当前行按二进制编号零至三。: The current row is numbered from zero to three in binary order.
零：德摩根；一：逆命题比较；二：逆否比较。完整四行验证的是二变量真值函数。: Zero: De Morgan; one: compare the converse; two: compare the contrapositive. All four rows verify the two-variable truth functions.
每行至少一个: A true cell in every row
一表示喜欢；两侧量词的见证依赖不同。: One means “likes.” The two quantifier orders allow different witness dependencies.
逐个例子检查分类；覆盖全体整数仍依靠代数式证明。: Individual examples check the cases; the algebraic proof covers all integers.
全集为零到七；甲为零、一、二、四，乙为二、三、四、六。当前：: The universe is zero through seven; A contains zero, one, two, four, and B contains two, three, four, six. Current operation:
模式零为三到三双射；一为碰撞且遗漏；二为三到四单射但不满射。: Mode zero: three-to-three bijection; one: collisions and missed targets; two: three-to-four injection, not onto.
零：不大于；一：整数距离不超过一；二：自环加相邻前向边。: Zero: less than or equal; one: integer distance at most one; two: loops plus adjacent forward edges.
有限窗口显示零到十一；每个整数仍只属于一个余数类。: The finite window shows zero through eleven. Every integer still belongs to exactly one residue class.
上方集合较大，边只画增加一个元素的覆盖关系；空集在底部。: Greater sets appear above; edges show only covers that add one element. The empty set is at the bottom.
步骤超过实际所需时停留在最终状态，不制造额外取余。: After the actual final step, the display stays at that state rather than inventing more divisions.
一既不是质数，也不是合数。: One is neither prime nor composite.
金点为最终余数；负数也采用非负标准代表。: The gold point marks the final remainder. Negative inputs also use nonnegative standard representatives.
窗口为零到十四；全部整数解每隔十五重复。: The window runs from zero to fourteen. All integer solutions repeat every fifteen.
从零格开始，每层加下一个奇数；代数恒等式给出一般归纳步骤。: Starting with zero cells, each layer adds the next odd number. The algebraic identity supplies the general inductive step.
零用空选择组成；六、七、八建立起点，此后加三。: Zero uses an empty selection. Six, seven, and eight establish the base cases; later values follow by adding three.
示例每层完整，是满二叉树的一类；公式不要求所有叶子同深。: This example has complete levels, a special kind of full binary tree. The formula does not require equal leaf depths.
目标数量为第一个参数；当前轮次超过目标时保持退出状态。: The first parameter sets the target count. Steps beyond it retain the exit state.
缩半次数是候选规模缩到一的模型，不等于所有实现的精确比较次数。: Halvings model reducing the candidate count to one, not the exact comparison count of every implementation.
显示尽量均匀的一种分配，说明这个普遍下界不能再提高。: An allocation as even as possible shows that the universal lower bound cannot be improved.
选择数量超过总数时，演示按总数截取并显示实际值。列表最多显示二十四项，计数为完整: If the requested count exceeds the total, this illustration clamps it and shows the actual count. At most twenty-four subsets are listed; counts include every subset.
行号从零开始；列超出当前行时按最后一列。: Rows start at zero. A column beyond the row is clamped to its last entry.
至多列前二十个分配；总计数包含全部。相邻隔板或两端隔板允许零份。: At most twenty allocations are listed; the count includes all. Adjacent bars and end bars permit zero allocations.
当前示例固定零初值，乘数和加数由控件给定。: This example fixes the initial value at zero. Controls set the multiplier and added constant.
横轴为总量，柱高为方案数；超过可达总量时系数为零。: The horizontal axis is total size and height is the number of ways. Beyond the reachable total, the coefficient is zero.
独立公平掷币，次数和正面数按控件；超出次数的正面数在演示中截至次数。: Independent fair tosses use the controlled trial and head counts. Requested heads above the trial count are clamped in this illustration.
模式：六环、链、星形、完全六图、完全三对三、两个三角形。: Modes: six-cycle, path, star, complete six-vertex graph, complete three-by-three graph, and two triangles.
金、蓝两色标出已展开点的距离奇偶；表格列出完整距离作对照。点击顶点可更换起点。: Gold and blue show distance parity for expanded vertices. The table gives full reference distances. Click a vertex to change the source.
\\text{边遍历与顶点遍历分别判断}: \text{Check edge traversal and vertex traversal separately}
金边显示找到的一条 Hamilton 圈；全枚举用于这些小图，不是任意规模的高效: Gold edges show one Hamilton cycle found. Exhaustive search is used only for these small graphs, not offered as an efficient general algorithm. Mode five uses two triangles sharing a vertex.
仅展示固定编号顺序的贪心着色，不声称最少；完全三对三不平面，虽满足普通边数界。: Only greedy coloring in the fixed vertex order is shown, with no claim of minimality. The complete three-by-three graph is nonplanar despite satisfying the ordinary edge bound.
前三模式为链、星、二叉树；最后是三角形加三点链，有五条边但不连通。: The first three modes are a path, star, and binary tree. The last is a triangle and a three-vertex path: five edges, but disconnected.
左右位置固定；颜色标出已访问节点，序列给出完整参考顺序。: Left and right positions are fixed. Color marks visited vertices; the sequence gives the complete reference order.
金边为当前森林；并列边按端点编号固定顺序，不声称生成树唯一。: Gold edges mark the current forest. Tied edges use a fixed endpoint order; uniqueness is not claimed.
一号为起点；当前边权非负。未确定的有限值仍可能改进。: Vertex one is the source. All current weights are nonnegative. Unsettled finite distances may still improve.
金边显示当前配对，下方序列为本轮增广路。第二模式含两左点争同一右点的 Hall: Gold edges show current pairs. The sequence below is this round's augmenting path. Mode two has a Hall obstruction: two left vertices compete for one right vertex.
连线表示关系，编号对应下方表格；金色表示当前选中或已接纳部分。: Edges show relations; numbers correspond to the table below. Gold marks selected or accepted parts.
点击顶点可更换搜索起点。: Click a vertex to change the search source.
横轴为总量，柱高为方式数或概率，金色为当前目标；每柱附精确数值。: The horizontal axis is total size; bar height is ways or probability. Gold marks the target; each bar includes its exact value.
已到本次演示的最后一步。: The illustration has reached its final step.
阴影为上确界周围的指定误差带；有限点列不等于无限集合。: The shaded band is the prescribed error around the supremum. The finite displayed sequence is not the infinite set.
分子范围由整数不等式精确计算；本次网格没命中，不表示区间里没有其他分母的有理数。: Integer inequalities compute the numerator range exactly. No hit for this denominator does not exclude rationals with other denominators.
直达距离与经原点绕行: Direct distance and detour through zero
平方根二的嵌套包围: Nested brackets for the square root of two
中点可作近似，半个区间宽度是解析误差界。: The midpoint approximates the root; half the bracket width is an analytic error bound.
选色只突出一部分项，没有改变原列；两条子列极限不同。: Highlighting selects terms without changing the original sequence. The two subsequential limits differ.
表中部分和为浮点近似；每块至少二分之一来自逐项不等式。: Table sums are floating-point approximations. The one-half bound per block follows from termwise inequalities.
相同项数的原序与重排: Original and rearranged orders at equal lengths
每轮两正一负，各原指标仍最终恰出现一次；有限差异不等于不同总和，一般结论见证明。: Each round takes two positive terms and one negative term; every original index eventually occurs exactly once. Finite differences do not imply distinct infinite sums; see the proof.
模式依次为闭区间、开区间、左闭右开区间；圆圈空心表示端点未包含。: Modes are closed, open, then left-closed right-open intervals. Hollow endpoints are excluded.
倒数集合与缺失聚点: Reciprocal set and its missing limit point
空心零是原集合缺失的聚点；它加入闭包。有限项本身的闭包不会额外含零。: The hollow zero is a missing limit point, added by closure. The closure of the finite displayed subset alone does not add zero.
有限开子覆盖留下的缺口: Gaps left by finite open subfamilies
目标集合是零到一开区间。任意有限子族都有正的最小左端，因此都漏点。: The target is the open unit interval. Every finite subfamily has a positive smallest left endpoint and therefore misses points.
每行都在对应对角位与新行不同；有限窗口演示同一个可用于任意行号的构造。: Each row differs from the new row at its diagonal position. The finite window illustrates a construction valid for any row index.
平方函数的统一局部估计: A uniform local estimate for squaring
输入使用严格小于半径；边界读数只是保守包络，不把有限采样当保证。: Inputs use strict inequality with the radius. Boundary readouts are a conservative envelope, not a guarantee inferred from finite sampling.
图中横轴为指标，纵轴为输出；输入列都趋零，输出却不同。: The horizontal axis is the index and the vertical axis output. Both input sequences tend to zero, but their outputs differ.
只画到纵坐标十，视窗截断不是函数上界。: The vertical window stops at ten. Clipping the view is not an upper bound on the function.
闭区间上的连续函数。: A continuous function on a closed interval.
曲线仅讨论负一到一开区间；两端空心，最高值只能逼近。: The curve is considered only on the open interval from negative one to one. Hollow endpoints are excluded; the supremum is approached but not attained.
符号包围证明至少存在一个根；唯一性需另证。: A sign bracket proves at least one root exists; uniqueness needs a separate proof.
当前中心不是零: The current center is not zero
绝对值模式的不可导反例在中心零观察；其他中心仍可导。: Observe the absolute-value nondifferentiability example at center zero. Other centers are differentiable.
有限曲线无法显示全部无限振荡；两条解析子列的导数值精确为负一与正一。: A finite curve cannot show infinitely many oscillations. The two analytic subsequences have exact derivative values negative one and positive one.
切线下界与割线上界: Tangent lower bound and chord upper bound
有理点一、无理点零：每个正长度小区间确界都是零和一。色块只画解析界，不用有限点模: One at rationals and zero at irrationals: every positive-length interval has infimum zero and supremum one. Blocks show analytic bounds, not finite samples pretending to model density.
矩形高度取整个小区间的解析确界。阶跃包含跳点端值，所以触碰跳点的小块也可能有间隙: Rectangle heights use analytic extrema on whole subintervals. A jump's endpoint value can cause a gap even in an interval merely touching the jump.
本图中的线性函数与阶跃函数都定义在整个实轴；两侧差商均使用该定义，不把区间外输入: Both the linear and step examples are defined on the entire real axis. Both one-sided quotients use those definitions without clamping inputs to the displayed interval.
全域函数与移动坏点: Whole-domain functions and moving bad points
幂函数极限在右端为一，其余为零；所选移动点的误差始终为二分之一。: The power limit is one at the right endpoint and zero elsewhere. The selected moving point has error exactly one half.
最大误差在右端取到，精确等于指标倒数。: The maximum error is attained at the right endpoint and equals the reciprocal index exactly.
尖峰在倒数处达到高度一；任意固定输入最终却都趋零。: The spike reaches height one at the reciprocal index, although every fixed input eventually has value zero.
函数级数的统一几何控制: Uniform geometric control of a function series
右端输入一达到此最坏误差，因此这里的预算也是精确全域上确界。: Input one attains this worst error. The budget is therefore the exact supremum over the whole domain.
对每个固定输入最终趋零；尖峰随指标向零移动，且零处始终为零。: Every fixed input eventually has value zero. The spike moves toward zero, whose value remains zero throughout.
内部闭区间上的几何级数: Geometric series on an interior closed interval
固定半径小于一时误差随项数消失；把半径推到一附近会失去统一余量。: For a fixed radius below one, the error vanishes with term count. Moving the radius toward one removes that uniform margin.
曲线为有限绘图，公式与读数给出解析量。坐标轴注明数值；可使用下方输入和滑块。: Curves are finitely drawn; formulas and readouts give analytic quantities. Axes show values; use the inputs and sliders below.
金色标记可水平拖动。: Gold markers can be dragged horizontally.
已到最小非零增量；理论极限见公式与读数。: The smallest nonzero increment is reached. See the formula and readouts for the theoretical limit.
已到本次参数范围终点。: The current parameter range has reached its endpoint.
